name: Contract Value Review
description: A finance review of a customer deal's contract value before the paper goes out: the customer, the total contract value in its currency, and what changed.

fields.label: Account owner
fields.description: The account executive who owns the deal.

fields.label: Total contract value
fields.description: The total over the full term, in the deal's currency.

fields.label: What changed
fields.description: Why finance should look at this value: new pricing, a discount, a change of term.
